scripts.check: find src seeds migrations scripts \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.test:db: docker run -d --name fablab-test-db -p 5433:5432 -e POSTGRES_USER=fablab -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=fablab -e POSTGRES_DB=fablab_test postgres:16-alpine
scripts.test: NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=postgres://fablab:fablab@localhost:5433/fablab_test JWT_SECRET=fablab-test-secret LAB_CLOSE_TIME=23:59 sh -c 'node-pg-migrate up >/dev/null && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/'
